subQuests.subQuestName: Wait until the following day (08:00 – 10:00)

402312801.text: Ah, that explains the loud noise I heard outside. So it was Dvalin who fell into the river...

402312802.text: Considering his size, the fact that he broke a single window and not the entire wall seems like a feat of magic in itself.

402312803.text: Thanks for helping with the repairs, you two. This place looks as good as new now.

402312804.text: Does that count as a great feat of alchemy, then?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and participate in the test

402310101.text: Alright, we made it. Time for round tw— Huh?

402310102.text: Was this bubble this color before? Is something wrong?

402310103.text: I'm not sure. It was like this when I came to check on things this morning.

402310105.text: Wh—What? That... That can't be! How would the power of the Abyss even get in there?

402310106.text: #You sure know your stuff, {NICKNAME}. That's where my head went too. But, I don't know... something is different about this power.

402310110.text: It seems to be in an "embryonic state." Like an egg that hasn't hatched, the dark clouds before a storm, or... an omen before disaster strikes.

402310111.text: Of course, the world within the magic bubble is imaginary, so the same should be true of this Abyssal power... at least for now.

402310112.text: You created this magic, right, Alice? Do you have any idea what's going on here?

402310113.text: New magic does often come with its issues. So, I can't say I'm entirely surprised something like this would crop up.

402310114.text: As for a solution, however, I'm afraid I need more information first.

402310115.text: One thing is for certain, at least... Given the current threat, we'll have to close off the bubble to event participants.

402310116.text: My apologies, Miss Alice. I know you've made a promise to Klee, but I'm not sure you'll be able to keep it.

402310118.text: Uh, have we ever seen Alice look this serious...?

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the anomalous bubble
Enter the anomalous bubble

402310302.text: Didn't we all come in at the same time? Where are the others?

402310303.text: The bubble must be highly unstable right now.

402310304.text: Look! There's Venti... surrounded by a whole bunch of monsters!

402310307.text: Ah, perfect timing. C'mon, let's show these unwelcome guests the door.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the monsters
Talk to Venti and go over the current situation

402310502.text: Very much so, thanks to your timely arrival. But, Mondstadt looks like it's in bad shape.

402310503.text: The story's all messed up now.

402310504.text: Yeah! The city's crawling with Abyssal monsters! It's almost like... we've already lost.

402310505.text: I'm not sure what happened, but the rest of our group might need backup. Let's find them first.

402310508.text: Look, it's Dvalin! Is it just Paimon, or... does he look way worse than back then?

402310509.text: You're right. The corruption has spread throughout his entire body. If we had failed to purify him in real life, I imagine this is what would have become of him.

402310510.text: Wait, it looks like something's falling!

402310512.text: Like the ones we purified in the past?

402310513.text: Yes, but at this point... These tears are essentially crystallizations of Abyssal power.

402310514.text: If left unchecked, they will continuously summon Abyssal monsters, and this disaster will never end.

402310515.text: We also need to get our hands on one of them.

402310516.text: Right, so I can purify it.

402310517.text: No, this degree of corruption cannot be cleansed. Besides, we need them in their corrupted state if we want to summon Dvalin.

402310518.text: I doubt the pure sound of the lyre can reach him in his current state.

402310519.text: Sounds like this whole thing is still gonna end in a confrontation, though. Just like back then...

402310520.text: Yes. I wasn't certain before Dvalin showed up, but now I'm sure this situation is more than simple chaos.

402310521.text: It seems more like... an alternate version of events, and I have some idea of how it came to be.

402310524.text: Well, monsters abound no matter where we look. You choose where to go, and I'll follow.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the tears and find your companions
Defeat the monsters
Collect the tears and find your companions

402311602.text: I know everything we encounter in this bubble is imaginary, but these monsters sure fight like the real thing. It's a bit too true to life.

402311603.text: Don't worry, as long as we collect Dvalin's tears, we can use this Abyssal power to our advantage.

402311604.text: I see... In that case, let's get moving.

402311605.text: Have you seen Varka, by the way? We haven't found him yet.

402311606.text: No, he might be at the upper levels. Let's search together.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the tears and find your companions
Defeat the monsters
Collect the tears and find your companions

402310601.text: Phew, made it. Thanks for the assist.

402310602.text: It looks like Mondstadt is in dire straits... Did you see any Knights or civilians on the way here?

402310604.text: Hm, then my initial suspicion could be right... The Knights have abandoned the city and evacuated all civilians to a different location.

402310606.text: In the face of unrelenting Abyssal attacks, it's possible they had no other choice. But, none of that matters now.

402310607.text: An empty city has its advantages. We won't need to divert our attention to protecting civilians, for one.

402310608.text: Oh, and this thing... It looks like one of Dvalin's tears. I don't feel good about just leaving it here.

402310609.text: That happens to be just what we were hoping to find. Let's take it with us.

402310610.text: Wait, what about Varka? Have you seen him?

402310611.text: No, I'm not sure where he is. We'll just have to keep looking.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the tears and find your companions

402310703.text: The Grand Master should be over there. C'mon, let's hurry.

402312701.text: Here, I'll draw him for you. Look, this is the bad guy who made a whole bunch of trouble for Daddy. It's all his fault Daddy couldn't make it back this time.

402312702.text: That big meanie! We should blow him up!

402312703.text: #That's right, he is a big meanie! But, thanks to the Honorary Knight and {M#his}{F#her} friends, he's not going to be much trouble anymore.

402312704.text: Yay! The Honorary Knight is the best!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the plaza in front of the Cathedral
Clear out the monsters present
Discuss what to do with everyone

402311001.text: Looks like we're all back together. Everyone in one piece?

402311002.text: Yes. The Honorary Knight arrived just in time to help us out.

402311003.text: Now that we've collected Dvalin's tears, the monster attacks appear to be easing up, too.

402311004.text: I'm sure you've noticed, Varka, but the city is pretty much a ghost town at this point.

402311005.text: Yeah, we should get out of here. No sense wasting our strength.

402311006.text: This place should be safe from monster attacks for now, at least.

402311007.text: Anyone there? The communication function bugged out again. Do you copy? It's me, Nicole. Alice just got back too.

402311008.text: Yeah, we can hear you now! What's going on!?

402311009.text: #When designing this experience, we cut out the part where {NICKNAME} cleanses the Abyssal power, and we didn't think to replace it with a different sequence of events. I think what we're witnessing is a direct result of that.

402311010.text: Alice and I thought the events in the bubble would be independent from each other.

402311011.text: But since the magic is contained in one place, it appears a causal link has formed between all the events within it...

402311012.text: And so, because Dvalin was never purified, we've encountered a major bug.

402311014.text: So, what we're witnessing now is like an alternate version of events where the Honorary Knight never appeared in Mondstadt.

402311015.text: #Wait but, even if {NICKNAME} never showed up, you could have done something, right, Venti?

402311016.text: The Abyss is a far greater enemy than one person can face. I could have handled that specific situation, sure, but it wouldn't have gone quite so well.

402311017.text: If I'm not mistaken, you've seen how that version of the story goes yourself, right, Varka? Through the mages' scryglass?

402311018.text: Yeah, it was a kind of... prophecy. It felt so real, I doubt I could ever forget it.

402311019.text: In the end... You were able to seal Dvalin away, but you were wounded in the process.

402311020.text: But if Dvalin was sealed, how did things get to this point?

402311021.text: Because a seal doesn't solve the root problem. Over time, the Abyss would just grow stronger and stronger, deteriorating Dvalin's consciousness until there was nothing left.

402311022.text: Wait, does that mean what we saw earlier was...

402311023.text: The aftermath of Dvalin breaking free from the seal... That's right. He is in dire straits.

402311024.text: The power of the Abyss has fused with his flesh and bones. Purifying him now, in this state, is no different than sentencing him to death.

402311026.text: So, if we want to resolve this crisis...

402311028.text: I know that sounds intense. But remember, this is a fictional world. The real Dvalin is right as rain, and a lot more mellow than this one, that's for sure.

402311029.text: We have our solution, so let's hop to it. Should be a piece of cake for a group like this.

402311030.text: No time to lose, right? We've got Klee waiting for us, after all.

402311031.text: Hahaha, she's playing somewhere else right now, so we do have some time. Of course, the sooner we resolve this the better.

402311032.text: ...You're right. This is the only way.

402311033.text: I know Dvalin means a lot to you. If this is too hard, you can leave it to us, y'know. No need to scar yourself over a game, right?

402311034.text: I'll be fine. I was... prepared for that possibility back then, too.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Stormterror's Lair
Go to Stormterror's Lair

402311203.text: Of course. I just hope I learned a thing or two since the first time around.

402311204.text: Haha, guess I'm the newbie, huh? Good thing I'm a quick learner, then.

402311205.text: #What about you, {NICKNAME}? This was your first big fight in Teyvat. Were you nervous back then? How about now?

402311206.text: I'm not nervous. We've all grown a lot since then.

402311207.text: We overcame this challenge once, and we can do it again.

402311209.text: Then let the mournful cries of this lyre, tainted and defiled, summon a familiar now utterly warped.

402311212.text: Turning the surging Abyss into musical notes is no simple task...

402311213.text: But how could I claim to be the finest bard in Teyvat if I didn't rise to the occasion?

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat Dvalin, who has been corrupted by the Abyss
Defeat Dvalin, who has been corrupted by the Abyss

402311401.text: The bubble crisis is resolved without incident, while Alice and Nicole fix the flaws in the magic to prevent any recurrence of the problems.

402311402.text: Klee doesn't notice a thing, and embarks on a relaxing adventure alongside her mother and Nicole.

402311403.text: Now, the only issue left for the Knights to resolve... might be the window Dvalin broke.

402311404.text: Looks like it was a happy ending after all.

402311405.text: It was kinda like a Choo-Choo Cart ride — it had its fun moments and its thrills. All in all, Paimon had a great time.

402311406.text: Guess it wasn't without some collateral damage, though... Sorry about the window, Jean.

402311407.text: It's fine. As long as the building itself is intact, I consider that a win. I'll arrange for the window to be replaced at a later date.

402311408.text: In any case, we were lucky Dvalin arrived when he did. It would have been tricky to deal with a flying opponent otherwise.

402311409.text: I suppose I could've created a gust of wind to whisk us up, but I'm not sure our gliders would have survived the process.

402311410.text: Honestly, after everything we faced, I can't believe Alice still decided to bring Klee in there to play. She's a daring one, that's for sure.

402311411.text: I mean, can we be certain there aren't other bugs that just haven't cropped up yet?

402311412.text: I suppose that speaks to the confidence the mages have in their magical mastery.

402311413.text: Heh, if I know Alice, the whole bubble could've been blown to bits, and Klee still wouldn't have had a single scratch.

402311414.text: Her abilities do speak for themselves, I suppose.

402311415.text: So, what now? Anyone down for a drink? My treat.

402311416.text: Hm, sounds like a great idea, but tonight, it's on me. I happen to have a bottle of fine wine set aside just for the expedition team.

402311417.text: Haha, even better. Count me in.

402311418.text: Say no more. You had me at " fine wine"!

402311419.text: Alright, let's head over to my place then. You're coming too, right, Jean?

402311420.text: I'm afraid not. There's still a lot of work to do...

402311421.text: So what? The world's not gonna end if you push it off. C'mon, we never get a chance like this.

402311422.text: Hm, I suppose that wouldn't be a problem... if you head back to headquarters with me after we're done and help make up the work.

402311423.text: Uh, on second thought. How about you just... join us when you're done with that!

402311424.text: What about you, Honorary Knight? Gonna tag along?

402311427.text: Okay. All's well that ends well, am I right? To the bar, haha!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk with everyone in the Knights of Favonius Headquarters
Talk with everyone in the Knights of Favonius Headquarters
Wait for Alice in the library

402311502.text: I'm glad. I wanted to thank you for helping me keep my promise to Klee. She had a splendid time in the bubble.

402311503.text: Nicole came with us to make sure all was in order and prevent any similar incidents from happening in the future.

402311504.text: *sigh* You live and you learn. It's rare, but even the Dodo-King isn't immune to a small slip-up here and there, I suppose.

402311506.text: Yes, quite. The recording work is done as well, so now all we have to do is play it on loop.

402311507.text: It should be smooth sailing from here on out. Anyone and everyone can now enjoy the bubble at their leisure.

402311508.text: Nicole will keep an eye on them, of course.

402311511.text: Hmm... I wouldn't put it quite like that. It was more like... a "fate that will not come to pass."

402311512.text: Huh? What's the difference between the two?

402311513.text: Let us not forget, the courageous dragon slayer in the story? Well, in real life, he had already left on an expedition to Nod-Krai at that time.

402311514.text: Of course, that doesn't mean Dvalin would have escaped his destined death, for another hero would have come along and paid a painful price for victory.

402311515.text: But, what we saw in the bubble was what happened after Dvalin broke free from the seal. So, couldn't Varka have been back by then?

402311516.text: Hehe... Dear Paimon, you're free to ponder such questions yourself, of course, but it's of little use to ask them aloud.

402311517.text: Word to the wise — do not lose sleep over all those "what ifs," over the "fates that will not come to pass." It's an exercise in futility.

402311518.text: Those who can observe fate see both the good and the bad of what could have happened.

402311519.text: But, all that matters is what did happen. Those alternate fates are nowhere near as important as the world that exists in the here and now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

402319901.text: Oh, I think I saw Jean on the other side of the city. I was going to head over after clearing out these monsters. We should go help her.

402319903.text: In that case, there's no time to waste. Let's head to the Cathedral.

402319904.text: Ah, right. I remember seeing Diluc on the other side of the city. We should go help him first.

402319905.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's go!

402319906.text: Better to find him soon than later. The Grand Master is an exceptional warrior, but this is the Abyss we're dealing with. You can never be too careful.

402319907.text: Alice loves going to the library. Let's wait for her there.

402319908.text: Whoa, looks like it's been fixed already.
